submitted.rationale: BiVO4 is the leading photoanode in the Bi-Fe-V system, so I focused on compositions with a Bi:V ratio near 1:1 and a little Fe. XRD showed that 14, 19 and 81 are phase-pure with a BiVO4-like pattern. Index 19 (Bi0.34 Fe0.20 V0.46) gave the highest photocurrent of the three I measured: 31.4 µA, against 23.9 µA for index 14 and 16.2 µA for index 81.

rejected.reason: Measured 16.2 µA; more Fe appears to lower the photocurrent
XRD shows a second phase (peak at Q=2.015), so a merit measurement was not spent on it
Bi-rich; XRD shows several secondary-phase peaks, so a merit measurement was not spent on it
